linhas.en:
Rin Tohsaka's first SG.
Rin herself describes it as:
"queenly behavior, imposed by one's nobility,
and completely natural for a ruler."
Indeed, its meaning is unclear.

Another name for it is "templation".
It comes from the word "template", as in model or standard,
and was a popular slang term in 21st century Japan.
             ◆

Humans may, in various moods and circumstances,
reject what they like by saying they don't like them,
or accept what they hate by saying they don't hate them.

The opposite of goodwill isn't ill will, but indifference.

To like is the other side of hate.
To hate is the other side of like.
This kind of "dishonesty" happens to everyone.
It's nothing to be particularly ashamed of.

However, there're also cases where those who are prideful
behave haughtily to the one they're interested in,
engaging in contradictory behavior.
But of course, we wouldn't dare say who.

This templation shifts from "my my, not being very honest"
to "uhh wait, aren't we enemies already?,"
a condition oddly specific to girls.

Their prideful act is called "tsuntsun", and when
their dependency reaches critical, they turn "deredere"―――
in other words, the completion of a "tsundere".

But of course, we wouldn't dare say who.

             ◆

Templation is fated to disappear when love is fulfilled,
so it could be called a bittersweet SG.
A certain priest said this.
"Once she confesses to her love interest and is fulfilled,
 she #RUBS   or anything#RUBEis 'tsun'#REND no longer. Only a despicable, impure being."

Unfortunately, all that lies past graduation from this SG
is becoming an idiotic couple so wrapped up in their love,
they don't even notice that people are watching.
If you're a well-meaning third party, you'll probably have
your own thoughts of it, but please kindly watch over them.
